answer.explanation: Throughout the window (22:27-22:37Z) the Thumbnailer logs about 35-40 AccessDenied errors per minute on s3:PutObject to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi/thumbnailer/*. The live inline policy app-policy on lambda-rca-bench-ThumbnailerRole-uSLz6w9BZbU1 only grants s3:GetObject on the input bucket. The intended template grants s3:PutObject on the output bucket (WriteOutput), so the role has drifted from the IaC. The live function configuration (OUTPUT_BUCKET env var, role ARN, memory, timeout) matches the template, and the template-level commits touching OUTPUT_BUCKET (a9f46ca, reverted in 96509c8) were already reverted before the window. The failure is therefore an execution-role permission problem, not a configuration or code problem.
